APG asks for one Tab stop only inside a composite widget and allows controls in the tab sequence. "One stop for the whole field" judges the extra stops.

APG asks for one Tab stop only inside a composite widget and allows controls in the tab sequence. "One stop for the whole field" judges the extra stops.
